dedupe_keys.name: a global drought dataset for multivariate composite drought index mcdi and its constituent drought indices

description: A global drought dataset for Multivariate Composite Drought Index (MCDI) and its constituent drought indices is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Mengjia Yuan et al. High-resolution drought index datasets are used in drought monitoring and assessment. Despite numerous global/regional drought index datasets, the composite drought index datasets that comprehensively consider meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological factors are still very few, thus hindering the capture of complex drought dynamics and risk assessment. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
